title: Gate encoding and decoding
statement: Let $S$ be a natural number and let $g$ be a gate with at most two arguments, each a natural number less than $S$. Encoding $g$ using the three gate labels and two bounded argument slots, then decoding that code, recovers $g$ exactly.
